alerts.headline: Flood Warning issued September 29 at 10:45AM EDT until October 1 at 12:00AM EDT by NWS Boston/Norton MA
alerts.description: ...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in Massachusetts... Taunton River Near Bridgewater affecting Plymouth and Bristol Counties. For the Taunton River...including Bridgewater...Minor flooding is forecast. * WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast. * WHERE...Taunton River near Bridgewater. * WHEN...Until late Wednesday night. * IMPACTS...At 9.0 feet…
alerts.instruction: Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars through flooded areas. Additional information is available at www.weather.gov. The next statement will be issued Wednesday morning at 1045 AM EDT.
